## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle bibliographic checklist of sub-commentaries (*jì* 記) on **Dàoxuān**'s ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)) *Sìfēnlǜ shānfán bǔquē xíngshì chāo* 四分律刪繁補闕行事鈔 ([KR6k0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0017)) compiled by the Southern Sòng Vinaya monk **Huìxiǎn** 慧顯 ([慧顯](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E9%A1%AF)) and revised in Japan by **Kaigetsu** 戒月 ([戒月](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%88%92%E6%9C%88)). The work catalogues the *liùshí jiā* 六十家 ("sixty houses") of Tang and Sòng *Xíngshì chāo* commentary by author and number of *juan* — a critical bibliographic resource for the medieval Vinaya tradition.

**Abstract**

The *Biāomù* is the principal medieval inventory of the Tang–Sòng *Xíngshì chāo* commentary tradition and the indispensable resource for reconstructing the *liùshí jiā* — most of whose works have not survived. Because most Tang *Nánshān* Vinaya commentary is lost, Huìxiǎn's catalogue (with Kaigetsu's *gǎilù* recension) preserves a list of authors and titles that would otherwise be unrecoverable. Dating: Huìxiǎn is recorded only as a Southern Sòng monk; the bracket here gives the Southern Sòng range. Kaigetsu's *gǎilù* belongs to the Tokugawa-era Japanese Manji-canon editorial enterprise.
